record.bible_text: <FO><FO>A Psalm<WH04210> of Asaph<WH0623>.<Fo><Fo> Truly God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> good<WH02896> to Israel<WH03478>, <FI>even<Fi> to such as are of a clean<WH01249> heart<WH03824>. <RF>of: or, for<Rf> <RF>Truly: or, Yet<Rf> <RF>of...: Heb. clean of heart<Rf>
But as for me, my feet<WH07272> were almost<WH04592> gone<WH05186><WTH8804><WTH8675><WH05186><WTH8803>; my steps<WH0838> had well nigh<WH0369> slipped<WH08210><WTH8795>.
For I was envious<WH07065><WTH8765> at the foolish<WH01984><WTH8802>, <FI>when<Fi> I saw<WH07200><WTH8799> the prosperity<WH07965> of the wicked<WH07563>.
For <FI>there are<Fi> no bands<WH02784> in their death<WH04194>: but their strength<WH0193> <FI>is<Fi> firm<WH01277>. <RF>firm: Heb. fat<Rf>

They <FI>are<Fi> not in trouble<WH05999> <FI>as other<Fi> men<WH0582>; neither are they plagued<WH05060><WTH8792> like<WH05973> <FI>other<Fi> men<WH0120>. <RF>in...: Heb. in the trouble of other men<Rf> <RF>like: Heb. with<Rf>
Therefore pride<WH01346> compasseth them about as a chain<WH06059><WTH8804>; violence<WH02555> covereth<WH05848><WTH8799> them <FI>as<Fi> a garment<WH07897>.
Their eyes<WH05869> stand out<WH03318><WTH8804> with fatness<WH02459>: they have more<WH05674><WTH8804> than heart<WH03824> could wish<WH04906>. <RF>have...: Heb. pass the thoughts of the heart<Rf>
They are corrupt<WH04167><WTH8686>, and speak<WH01696><WTH8762> wickedly<WH07451> <FI>concerning<Fi> oppression<WH06233>: they speak<WH01696><WTH8762> loftily<WH04791>.
They set<WH08371><WTH8804> their mouth<WH06310> against the heavens<WH08064>, and their tongue<WH03956> walketh<WH01980><WTH8799> through the earth<WH0776>.
Therefore his people<WH05971> return<WH07725><WTH8799><WTH8675><WH07725><WTH8686> hither<WH01988>: and waters<WH04325> of a full<WH04392> <FI>cup<Fi> are wrung out<WH04680><WTH8735> to them.
And they say<WH0559><WTH8804>, How doth God<WH0410> know<WH03045><WTH8804>? and is there<WH03426> knowledge<WH01844> in the most High<WH05945>?
Behold, these <FI>are<Fi> the ungodly<WH07563>, who prosper<WH07961> in the world<WH05769>; they increase<WH07685><WTH8689> <FI>in<Fi> riches<WH02428>.
Verily I have cleansed<WH02135><WTH8765> my heart<WH03824> <FI>in<Fi> vain<WH07385>, and washed<WH07364><WTH8799> my hands<WH03709> in innocency<WH05356>.
For all the day<WH03117> long have I been plagued<WH05060><WTH8803>, and chastened<WH08433> every morning<WH01242>. <RF>chastened: Heb. my chastisement was<Rf><CM>
If I say<WH0559><WTH8804>, I will speak<WH05608><WTH8762> thus<WH03644>; behold, I should offend<WH0898><WTH8804> <FI>against<Fi> the generation<WH01755> of thy children<WH01121>.
When I thought<WH02803><WTH8762> to know<WH03045><WTH8800> this, it <FI>was<Fi> too painful<WH05999> for me<WH05869>; <RF>too...: Heb. labour in mine eyes<Rf>
Until I went<WH0935><WTH8799> into the sanctuary<WH04720> of God<WH0410>; <FI>then<Fi> understood<WH0995><WTH8799> I their end<WH0319>.
Surely thou didst set<WH07896><WTH8799> them in slippery places<WH02513>: thou castedst them down<WH05307><WTH8689> into destruction<WH04876>.
How are they <FI>brought<Fi> into desolation<WH08047>, as in a moment<WH07281>! they are utterly<WH05486><WTH8804> consumed<WH08552><WTH8804> with terrors<WH01091>.
As a dream<WH02472> when <FI>one<Fi> awaketh<WH06974><WTH8687>; <FI>so<Fi> , O Lord<WH0136>, when thou awakest<WH05782>, thou shalt despise<WH0959><WTH8799> their image<WH06754>.<CM>
Thus my heart<WH03824> was grieved<WH02556><WTH8691>, and I was pricked<WH08150><WTH8709> in my reins<WH03629>.
So foolish<WH01198> <FI>was<Fi> I, and ignorant<WH03045><WTH8799>: I was <FI>as<Fi> a beast<WH0929> before thee. <RF>ignorant: Heb. I knew not<Rf> <RF>before Heb. with<Rf>
Nevertheless I <FI>am<Fi> continually<WH08548> with thee: thou hast holden<WH0270><WTH8804> <FI>me<Fi> by my right<WH03225> hand<WH03027>.
Thou shalt guide<WH05148><WTH8686> me with thy counsel<WH06098>, and afterward<WH0310> receive<WH03947><WTH8799> me <FI>to<Fi> glory<WH03519>.
Whom have I in heaven<WH08064> <FI>but thee<Fi> ? and <FI>there is<Fi> none upon earth<WH0776> <FI>that<Fi> I desire<WH02654><WTH8804> beside thee.

My flesh<WH07607> and my heart<WH03824> faileth<WH03615><WTH8804>: <FI>but<Fi> God<WH0430> <FI>is<Fi> the strength<WH06697> of my heart<WH03824>, and my portion<WH02506> for ever<WH05769>. <RF>strength: Heb. rock<Rf>
For, lo, they that are far<WH07369> from thee shall perish<WH06><WTH8799>: thou hast destroyed<WH06789><WTH8689> all them that go a whoring<WH02181><WTH8802> from thee.

But<WH0589> <FI>it is<Fi> good<WH02896> for me to draw near<WH07132> to God<WH0430>: I have put<WH07896><WTH8804> my trust<WH04268> in the Lord<WH0136> GOD<WH03069>, that I may declare<WH05608><WTH8763> all thy works<WH04399>.<CM>
